column1: # Asset manifest: every non-code byte range of the ROM, read by tools/assets.py.
# Columns: start end type path [options]. Addresses are ROM addresses; end is exclusive.
# Boundaries and formats follow wiki/rom/rom-map.md; types are described in tools/assets.py.
# Changing a range or type: run `tools/dr python3 tools/assets.py check`, then `gen-data`, then `make setup`.
# Cartridge header after the entry branch (Nintendo logo, title, codes); used by asm/crt0.s.
# .rodata 1: string literals and small tables (see wiki/game/text-system.md).
# Kanji sheets have one Shift-JIS lead byte per row (192 glyphs); Latin sheets are in Windows-1252 order.
# Per-card block, indexed by card ID 0-820 (wiki/data/card-table.md).
